rationale: No evidence-supported optimization applies to this workflow without weakening coverage or adding unsupported assumptions. The cancel-superseded-runs pattern (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is already satisfied by the existing concurrency block with cancel-in-progress: true scoped to the workflow and PR ref. The measured pip-cache optimization (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE / batch-hiruni) and the dependency-download cache pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) require a dependency-installation step, which this dependency-review job lacks, so a cache would add overhead with nothing to restore or save. There is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST inapplicable), no tests to prioritize or select (P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-SELECT inapplicable), no completed-run history for timeout derivation (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT inapplicable; ci_history shows no completed runs), and no Bazel or reusable environment snapshot (P-LIT-BAZEL-*, P-LIT-ENV-CACHE inapplicable).
